chunks: First: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Salih ibn Sa'id from al-Husayn ibn Khalid from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

He was asked about a man who had a female slave and manumitted her partially (mukattabah), and the slave said: 'Whatever I have paid of my manumission contract, I am free by virtue of that.' He said to her: 'Yes.' Then she paid part of her manumission contract, and her master had intercourse with her after that. He (peace be upon him) said: 'If he forced her to do that, he is flogged with a number of lashes corresponding to what she had paid of her manumission contract, and the remainder of the lashes is deferred from him corresponding to what remained of her manumission contract. And if she consented, she is his partner in the punishment; she is flogged just as he is flogged.'

As for what Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated from al-Halabi, who said: 'I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his mukattabah slave.' He said: 'If she had paid one-quarter, he is flogged; and if he is muhsan (married/free), he is stoned. And if she had not paid anything, there is no punishment upon him.' This does not contradict the first narration because the first narration can be interpreted according to the detail contained in the second narration, that he is flogged proportionally for what is less than one-quarter. When the one-quarter of manumission is reached, its ruling prevails over him, so he is flogged completely or stoned according to his condition.

key_terms.مُكَاتَبَة: Manumission contract where a slave pays a specific sum for freedom

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a master who has intercourse with his partially manumitted slave?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar elucidates the nuanced fiqh of *mukattabah* (a slave with a manumission contract) by reconciling two narrations regarding the master's sexual intercourse with her. It establishes that the punishment is proportional to the paid portion of her freedom if coerced, or shared if consensual, while clarifying that once she pays one-quarter, she attains the status of a free woman for hadd purposes, a principle rooted in the gradual nature of her emancipation.
